channel.title: Global Africa Network Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Africa Network Media (globalafricanetwork.com)

item.title: Large-scale onshore salmon farming operation in the Northern Cape in progress
item.description: Southern African Atlantic Salmon (SAAS) aims to establish the first large-scale onshore Atlantic salmon farming operation in South Africa, using cutting-edge Norwegian flow-through technology.

item.title: Alternative waste treatment project seeks private sector partners (PPP)
item.description: This project presents a strategic investment opportunity in clean energy, waste management and sustainable urban infrastructure. Seeking private sector partners (PPP).

item.title: Groundbreaking technology: Shaping the future of mining
item.description: CTC Plant Company and Tempo Equipment and Attachments deliver innovative attachments that drive productivity and safety.

item.title: Showcase your products at in-cosmetics Global 2026 in Paris, France from 14-16 April 2026
item.description: The DTIC extends an invitation to South African exporters to apply to participate on the Outward Selling Mission (OSM) to the in-cosmetics Global exhibition scheduled to take place 14 - 16 April 2026 in Paris. Deadline for submission is 31 January 2026.

item.title: Cost-effective base for scaling digitally-oriented business operations
item.description: Industrial Development Zone ideally positioned for BPO operators, data service providers, ICT manufacturers, software developers and smart technology innovators seeking a cost-effective base serving both domestic and export markets.

item.title: Prime industrial precinct expanding to accommodate more investors
item.description: The SEZ provides long-term notarial leasehold contracts to help commercial property developers lower upfront land costs and establish a lasting public-private partnership.

item.title: Energy: The cornerstone of Africa’s infrastructure development
item.description: By aligning energy availability with infrastructure projects, Africa can unlock efficiencies, reduce project risks, and attract private capital for long-term, sustainable growth.

item.title: Scale up your business at OR Tambo International Airport SEZ Precinct 2
item.description: This new precinct offers unmatched proximity to OR Tambo International Airport and direct access to high-performing logistics infrastructure.

item.title: Investment opportunity in (combined) tourism and farming project
item.description: The project incorporates the development of accommodation, tourism and game farming as well as sheep farming on a 395 hectare farm in the Free State.

item.title: Untapped tourism investment opportunities in the Free State
item.description: The Free State Province is home to several strategic and unique natural and cultural assets that offer significant opportunities for tourism investment through strategic partnerships.
